name: Marbling Dissolve
description: The second clip floats onto the first in thin bands of ink that a rake drags into zigzags and a fine comb pulls into feathers, like marbled paper; the bands widen until they cover the frame and the combs pull back out, leaving the second clip clean. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: tines
params.description: Number of teeth of the rake dragged up and down, along the longer side of the frame

params.name: pull
params.description: How far the teeth of the rake drag the picture, in frame heights (the fine comb drags it 0.6 times as far)

params.name: bands
params.description: Number of bands of ink across the frame

params.name: veins
params.description: How dark the thin lines of ink between the two clips are
